import random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
import planning
from common import validate
from plan_bruteforce import make, brute
from plan_cross import big, run
for seed in range(600):
    job = big(seed, nonbinding=(seed % 2 == 0))
    rnd = random.Random(seed * 13 + 5)
    active = {r['id']: rnd.random() < 0.85 for r in job['requests']}
    flow = run(job, active, 'flow')
    ctx = validate(job)
    use = {}
    for row in flow['assignments']:
        use[row['offer']] = use.get(row['offer'], 0) + 1
    bad = {o: k for o, k in use.items() if k > ctx['offers'][o]['capacity']}
    if bad:
        print('seed', seed, 'bad', bad)
        print('offers', job['offers'])
        print('requests', [(r['id'], r['group'], r['service']) for r in job['requests']])
        print('assignments', [(a['request'], a['offer']) for a in flow['assignments']])
        print('rq', job['request_quotas'], 'oq', job['offer_quotas'])
        break
EOF
